other_conditions: Applicant must be an Arunachal Pradesh domicile.
Homestay beneficiaries must be registered with the Department of Tourism.
Preference is given to Homestay operators who have been trained by the Department of Tourism.
Cab service operators, patisseries, and food courts must be registered as tour operators with the Department of Tourism.
benefits_summary: Direct loan subsidy of up to ₹5 lakh for opening patisseries, homestays, and procuring adventure tourism equipment.
